fields.description: Display name for this notification group.
fields.label: Title

fields.description: Lowercase id used in the webhook URL (/api/method/notifire.api.webhook?group=<slug>). Auto-filled from the title; lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only.
fields.label: Slug

fields.description: Disabled groups behave like unknown endpoints (they require the global secret before the 404 is revealed).
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Receives webhooks whose site does not match any group hostname (or is absent). Only one group can be the fallback.
fields.label: Fallback group

fields.description: Accepted in the X-Webhook-Secret header for this endpoint. Generated automatically when you save; use 'Rotate Secret' in the form to replace it. The global fallback secret from Notifire Settings also works.
fields.label: Webhook secret

fields.description: One hostname per row. A single Frappe Cloud account can serve many benches/sites - list every hostname whose webhooks should route to this group. Hostnames are unique across all groups and stored lowercase.
fields.label: Site hostnames
